title_zh: Apple 智能备案新增 iPad 和笔记本
content_zh:
网信上海 11 月 9 日发布公告，Apple 智能生成式人工智能服务新增苹果平板和笔记本电脑两类适用场景，已完成备案。变更后的适用范围包括苹果手机、平板和笔记本电脑。

公告所列备案主体为苹果技术开发（上海）有限公司，原备案日期为 7 月 8 日，此次场景变更日期为 11 月 9 日。
title_en: Apple Intelligence Expands Regulatory Approval in China to Cover iPads and MacBooks
content_en:
Apple Intelligence has expanded its official generative AI registration in China to include iPads and Mac laptops, according to a notice released by the Cyberspace Administration of Shanghai on November 9.

With this update, the regulatory filing officially covers iPhones, iPads, and MacBooks. The registered entity remains Apple Technology Development (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., which originally received approval on July 8 before updating its scope in November.

title_zh: 英伟达逆势大跌 4.27%，一夜蒸发 1.29 万亿元
content_zh:
美东时间 11 月 9 日，英伟达股价收跌 4.27%，报 178.67 美元，单日市值缩水约 1921 亿美元，折合人民币约 1.29 万亿元。目前，英伟达总市值约为 4.31 万亿美元。

当天美股三大股指集体上涨，其中纳斯达克综合指数涨幅达 2.74%，英伟达却逆势下跌。盘中其股价一度跌至 170.24 美元，较前一交易日收盘价跌幅接近 9%。

此次股价下跌正值英伟达管理层面临调查。据路透社报道，英伟达董事会于 11 月 8 日宣布启动独立调查，以核实 CEO 黄仁勋是否曾成为外国情报活动的目标。调查由独立董事委员会及外部法律顾问负责。

英伟达在官方声明中强调，目前没有理由认为美国国家安全或公司商业机密受到损害。董事会仍对黄仁勋及其管理团队保持信心，黄仁勋本人也承诺配合调查。

路透社指出，调查可能加剧投资者对英伟达管理层稳定性的担忧。与此同时，市场对 AI 基础设施投资可持续性的疑虑也持续影响科技股表现。

此前，英伟达股价已于 11 月 5 日大跌 9.26%，虽然次日反弹 2.78%，但最新一轮下跌使其股价再度承压。
title_en: Nvidia Shares Fall 4.27% Bucking Market Rally Amid Board Investigation into CEO Jensen Huang
content_en:
Nvidia stock bucked a broader market rally on November 9, closing down 4.27% at $178.67 and wiping out roughly $192.1 billion in market capitalization in a single day. The sharp decline occurred even as the Nasdaq Composite rose 2.74%, with Nvidia's stock plummeting nearly 9% intraday to a low of $170.24.

The pullback follows an announcement by Nvidia's board of directors initiating an independent investigation to determine whether CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by foreign intelligence activities. The probe, led by an independent board committee and external counsel, comes with reassurances from Nvidia that there is no indication of compromised national security or trade secrets. The board reaffirmed its full confidence in Huang, who committed to cooperating fully with the inquiry.

The investigation has intensified investor concerns over executive stability, while ongoing market skepticism regarding the long-term sustainability of AI infrastructure spending continues to weigh heavily on tech stocks.

title_zh: 曝苹果调整 iOS 28 开发节奏，首阶段留出六周探索功能
content_zh:
据彭博社 Mark Gurman 报道，苹果已调整下一代操作系统 iOS 28 的开发流程，首个开发阶段（M1）留出六周用于编码、探索和功能开发，随后仅有两周用于整合。

报道称，苹果目前已深入推进明年的新系统开发，其中 iOS 28 和 iPadOS 28 代号为 Bell，macOS 28 代号为 Poppy。

按照惯例，苹果每年的新系统开发分为 M1、M2、M3 三个主要阶段，每个阶段持续八周，包含四周编码和四周整合，整合指的是将各项功能集成进操作系统。

此次 M1 阶段，苹果没有沿用两个四周的常规安排，而是让工程师先用六周进行编码、探索和功能开发，再用两周完成整合。报道提到，有员工表示喜欢这一变化，认为这样能在功能锁定前留出更多时间构思和尝试。

报道同时提到，苹果新任 CEO John Ternus 对公司 AI 进展并不满意，近几周已与软件负责人 Craig Federighi 举行闭门会议，希望其加快 AI 路线图。
title_en: Apple Adjusts iOS 28 Development Schedule to Boost Feature Exploration Amid AI Push
content_en:
Apple has revised its software development workflow for next year's major operating system updates, including iOS 28 (codenamed "Bell") and macOS 28 (codenamed "Poppy"), according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. Under the new approach, the initial development stage (M1) allocates six weeks for coding and feature exploration, followed by a condensed two-week integration phase.

Traditionally, Apple structures its software development into three eight-week cycles (M1, M2, and M3), usually splitting time evenly with four weeks for coding and four weeks for integrating features into the core OS. Engineers reportedly welcome the new schedule, as the extended timeframe provides more flexibility to test creative ideas before features are locked down.

The shift comes amid reported pressure from Apple management to accelerate artificial intelligence development. CEO John Ternus has held closed-door meetings with software chief Craig Federighi to push for a faster AI roadmap after expressing dissatisfaction with the company's progress.

title_zh: 曝玛莎拉蒂拟与尊界合作，新车将由江淮生产
content_zh:
据第一财经 11 月 9 日报道，玛莎拉蒂母公司 Stellantis 正与华为、江淮推进一项名为「玛莎拉蒂 Design」的新车项目。报道称，新车外观已经确定，计划在 2027 年第四季度迎来进一步的量产进展。

知情人士称，项目将由江淮负责制造，华为参与提供支持。新车计划在国内由尊界销售，在海外沿用玛莎拉蒂标识。
title_en: Stellantis Reportedly Partnering with Huawei and JAC Motors for 'Maserati Design' EV
content_en:
Stellantis, the parent company of Maserati, is reportedly advancing a new vehicle project named "Maserati Design" in collaboration with Huawei and JAC Motors, according to a report by Yicai on November 9. The exterior design has already been finalized, with mass production expected to progress further in the fourth quarter of 2027.

Under the reported arrangement, JAC Motors will handle manufacturing while Huawei provides technical support. The upcoming vehicle is planned to be sold in China under Huawei's MAEXTRO brand, while retaining the Maserati badge in overseas markets.

title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 和 Mythos 5.2，两款模型 API 降价
content_zh:
Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.2 和 Mythos 5.2。两款产品共用同一个底层模型，开放范围由安全设置区分：Fable 会拦截渗透测试、漏洞利用代码生成及多数生物研究类请求，符合条件的网络安全或生命科学研究机构可申请使用 Mythos。

Anthropic 称，新模型生成速度较 5.1 版最高快 30%。标准 API 价格降至每百万输入 token 8 美元、每百万输出 token 40 美元。Fable 5.2 已登陆 Claude 平台及 AWS、Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Azure。

在发布前测试中，Anthropic 用模型把费马大定理的既有证明写成了可由程序检查的形式化证明。在公司的 FrontierSWE v2 编程评测中，Fable 5.2 得分为 69.9%，Fable 5.1 为 56.3%。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，Claude Fable 5.2 登顶世界第一，一夜斩杀 Opus 5.5
title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 with Lower API Pricing
content_en:
Anthropic has released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, two models built on the same underlying architecture but differentiated by safety guardrails. Fable 5.2 restricts requests involving penetration testing, exploit code generation, and most biological research, while verified cybersecurity and life sciences organizations can apply to access Mythos 5.2.

The updated models deliver up to 30% faster generation speeds compared to version 5.1. Standard API pricing has been reduced to $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. Fable 5.2 is currently available on the Claude platform as well as AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

During pre-release testing, Fable 5.2 achieved a score of 69.9% on Anthropic's FrontierSWE v2 coding benchmark, up from 56.3% on Fable 5.1. Anthropic also showcased the model's math reasoning by converting existing proofs of Fermat's Last Theorem into machine-verifiable formal proofs.

title_zh: 谷歌发布两套第八代 TPU 系统，分别面向长上下文和保密推理
content_zh: 谷歌 11 月 9 日公布 TPU 8i Max 和 TPU 8tx，扩充今年 4 月亮相的第八代 TPU 阵容。两套系统沿用现有芯片，分别调整了芯片封装和配套硬件。
title_en: Google Expands 8th-Gen TPU Lineup with TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx
content_en:
Google announced two new hardware systems, the TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx, on November 9 to expand its eighth-generation TPU family introduced earlier this year in April.

Targeting long-context processing and confidential inference respectively, both systems utilize Google's existing TPU silicon while featuring redesigned chip packaging and tailored supporting hardware.

title_zh: 迪士尼与 Adobe 达成多年合作，将为旗下 IP 定制生成模型
content_zh:
迪士尼与 Adobe 宣布达成多年合作。Adobe 将向迪士尼提前开放最新的创作和媒体工具，并提供工程与研究资源。双方将用 Firefly Foundry 开发迪士尼专用的生成模型，把角色特征、场景和视觉风格纳入模型训练。

迪士尼的幻想工程研发团队已在主题乐园开发中使用这套工具，例如将手绘草图转成完整的二维概念图。合作还覆盖华特迪士尼影业的 StudioLAB 和 ESPN Edge，后者将探索用 AI 整理和利用体育档案，并尝试新的内容呈现方式。
title_en: Disney Partners with Adobe to Build Custom AI Models for Iconic IP
content_en:
Disney and Adobe have announced a multi-year partnership to build custom generative AI models tailored to Disney's vast library of intellectual property. Powered by Adobe’s Firefly Foundry platform, the models will be trained on specific character traits, set designs, and visual styles, supported by dedicated engineering and research resources from Adobe.

Disney Imagineering is already utilizing these tools to streamline theme park development, such as automatically converting hand-drawn sketches into fully realized 2D concept art. The collaboration also encompasses Walt Disney Studios' StudioLAB and ESPN Edge, with ESPN exploring AI to organize sports archives and create innovative content experiences.

title_zh: 詹姆斯·古恩将卸任 DC 影业联席 CEO，前漫威高管接掌创意
content_zh:
Skydance 宣布，曾参与搭建漫威电影宇宙的杰里米·拉查姆将于 12 月 1 日出任 DC 影业总裁兼首席创意官，统筹电影、电视和动画业务。詹姆斯·古恩与彼得·萨夫兰将卸下管理职务，回归创作和制片。

拉查姆曾参与制作《钢铁侠》《复仇者联盟》和《银河护卫队》。古恩编剧并执导的超人续集《Man of Tomorrow》目前处于后期制作，计划于 2027 年 7 月 9 日上映，古恩和萨夫兰仍共同担任制片人。
title_en: Ex-Marvel Executive Jeremy Latcham Takes Lead at DC Studios as James Gunn Steps Down
content_en:
Skydance has announced that former Marvel Studios executive Jeremy Latcham will become President and Chief Creative Officer of DC Studios on December 1, taking charge of film, television, and animation divisions. Co-CEOs James Gunn and Peter Safran will step down from corporate management to return to hands-on writing and producing.

Latcham played a key role in launching the Marvel Cinematic Universe, with producing credits on blockbuster hits including *Iron Man*, *The Avengers*, and *Guardians of the Galaxy*. Meanwhile, Gunn's upcoming sequel *Man of Tomorrow*, which he wrote and directed, is currently in post-production and slated for release on July 9, 2027, with Gunn and Safran remaining attached as producers.

title_zh: 💡 瑞银 CEO：AI 股回调前，市场一直按「完美情景」定价
content_zh:
据路透社报道，瑞银首席执行官塞尔吉奥·埃尔莫蒂 11 月 9 日在悉尼出席瑞银会议时表示，过去数周 AI 股票的明显回调，反映出投资者此前对行业的预期过高。他仍看好 AI 带来的经济收益，但认为市场高估了这些收益兑现的速度。

埃尔莫蒂提到，美国中期选举结果，以及全球围绕 AI 基础设施建设影响的争论，都可能拖慢行业取得成果的进度。

他也以瑞银为例说明企业落地的速度。瑞银在 2023 年同意收购瑞信，埃尔莫蒂表示，随后的整合工作拖慢了瑞银内部部分 AI 应用的落地。
title_en: AI Stocks Were Priced for 'Perfection' Before Recent Pullback, Warns UBS CEO
content_en:
Speaking at a UBS conference in Sydney, UBS Chief Executive Sergio Ermotti stated that the recent pullback in artificial intelligence stocks indicates investors had set unrealistic expectations. While Ermotti remains confident in the long-term economic upside of AI, he cautioned that markets have overestimated how quickly those financial returns will materialize.

Ermotti highlighted several factors that could delay widespread AI adoption, including political uncertainty following U.S. midterm elections and global debates over infrastructure costs. He pointed to UBS's own experience as an example, noting that the integration of Credit Suisse following its 2023 acquisition has temporarily slowed down internal AI deployment within the bank.

title_zh: 比亚迪第 1900 万辆新能源汽车下线，方程豹钛 9 同日开订
content_zh:
11 月 9 日，比亚迪第 1900 万辆新能源汽车在西安工厂下线，下线车型为方程豹钛 9。同一天，方程豹开启钛 9 的全国预订，并公布顶配版配置。

钛 9 是一款采用方正车身的大六座插混 SUV，搭载比亚迪 DMS 混动平台和第二代刀片电池，配备云辇-A 车身控制系统。顶配版增加了 1.1 米全景抬头显示和 30 英寸座舱屏。新浪汽车报道称，新车将于 11 月内正式上市。
title_en: BYD Hits 19 Million NEV Milestone with Rollout of Fangchengbao Tai 9 SUV
content_en:
BYD achieved a major production milestone on November 9 as its 19 millionth new energy vehicle (NEV)—a Fangchengbao Tai 9—rolled off the assembly line at its Xi'an plant. On the same day, the company opened nationwide pre-orders for the flagship model and revealed details of its top-tier configuration.

The Tai 9 is a large, boxy six-seater plug-in hybrid SUV built on BYD’s DMS hybrid platform. It features the company's second-generation Blade Battery and the DiSus-A intelligent body control system. The high-end variant comes equipped with advanced cabin tech, including a 1.1-meter panoramic head-up display (HUD) and a 30-inch cockpit screen. The SUV is scheduled for an official market launch later this month.

title_zh: 千问办公 2.0 发布，团队可共享资料并让 AI 按消息触发任务
content_zh:
千问办公 11 月 9 日发布 2.0 版。团队可以在协作空间里关联钉钉群聊、听记、表格和文档，管理并指派任务。成员通过即时通讯交办后，数字员工「小 Q」可以结合空间里的资料梳理项目进展、设置待办。成员也可以查看、纠正或停用空间记忆。

新版支持按消息触发自动任务，首批规则包括收到指定联系人发来的消息，以及在指定群里被 @。纯云端任务在电脑关机后仍可运行，用户可以在网页端或桌面端修改、停用规则，并查看执行结果和失败原因。

修改 AI 生成的内容时，用户可以选中具体的段落、单元格、幻灯片或应用区域，一次提交多处修改意见，由 AI 在原有成果上直接修改。
title_en: Qwen Office 2.0 Launches with Automated Workflows and Shared Workspace Intelligence
content_en:
Qwen Office released version 2.0 on November 9, introducing enhanced collaborative capabilities for teams. Users can now link DingTalk group chats, meeting transcripts, spreadsheets, and documents within a shared workspace. Its digital AI assistant, "Xiao Q," leverages this unified data to track project progress, manage to-do lists, and execute assigned tasks, while team members retain full control to view, correct, or pause the AI's workspace memory.

The update also introduces message-triggered workflow automation. Tasks can now automatically execute when specific contacts send messages or when users are tagged in group chats. These cloud-based rules continue to run even after shutting down a computer, complete with execution logs accessible via desktop or web interfaces.

Additionally, the new version refines AI content editing by allowing users to select specific paragraphs, cells, slides, or interface areas to submit batch feedback for direct AI revisions.

title_zh: 英伟达推出 GR00T 2，让机器人从人类示范中学习精细操作
content_zh:
英伟达在 11 月 9 日的机器人学习大会 CoRL 上公布 GR00T 2、训练框架 Isaac Lab 3.0，以及两套面向工业操作的开放评测。新模型基于 NVIDIA Cosmos，能从人类示范中学习，也能把技能迁移到不同的机器人本体上。

英伟达称，在其评估的 50 项任务中，GR00T 2 没看过对应任务示范时，有 40 项至少成功完成过一次。每项提供一次示范后，平均成功率为 71%，增加到五次示范后为 95%。

Isaac Lab 3.0 可用 AI 智能体搭建训练环境，并在 PhysX 和 Newton 两套物理求解器之间切换。同期公布的 DexBench 覆盖零售、物流、制造和酒店服务四类场景，VABAR 则为六项工业任务提供标准化的条件变化、难度和成功指标。
title_en: NVIDIA Unveils GR00T 2 to Advance Robotic Manipulation via Human Demonstration
content_en:
NVIDIA announced GR00T 2 alongside its Isaac Lab 3.0 training framework and two industrial benchmark suites at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) on November 9. Built on NVIDIA Cosmos, the new foundation model enables robots to learn fine manipulation skills from human demonstrations and transfer those capabilities across different robot hardware.

GR00T 2 showed high learning efficiency across 50 evaluated tasks. Without prior demonstrations, the model achieved at least one successful attempt in 40 of the tasks. Providing a single human demonstration raised the average success rate to 71%, which climbed to 95% with five demonstrations.

Accompanying the model, Isaac Lab 3.0 allows AI agents to construct training environments and seamlessly switch between PhysX and Newton physics engines. NVIDIA also introduced DexBench, covering retail, logistics, manufacturing, and hospitality scenarios, as well as VABAR, which provides standardized evaluation metrics for industrial tasks.

title_zh: 字节跳动发布 Seedream 5.5，生成图片可直接带透明背景
content_zh:
字节跳动 Seed 团队 11 月 9 日发布图像模型 Seedream 5.5。新模型可直接生成带 Alpha 通道的图片，透明和半透明的部分可以保留下来，生成的元素可直接用作独立设计素材。

团队也展示了同一张人物图连续编辑 100 轮的结果。每轮以前一张图为底稿，先后修改服装、配饰和桌面物件，到后段仍能单独调整戒指、镜框等细节。Seed 称，这一版针对局部编辑做了专项训练，以减少未修改区域在反复生成中的偏色和细节流失。

新版也改善了光照、材质、皮肤纹理和密集小字的渲染，正陆续在即梦、豆包、豆包工作和火山方舟上线。

🔗 相关阅读：谁家 AI 这么听劝？Seedream 5.5 爆改 iPhone Duo 界面，精准到像素级
title_en: ByteDance Unveils Seedream 5.5 with Native Transparency and Multi-Round Precision Editing
content_en:
ByteDance's Seed team has released Seedream 5.5, an upgraded image generation model that natively supports Alpha channel transparency. The model preserves transparent and semi-transparent elements directly, allowing generated outputs to be used immediately as standalone graphic design assets.

The update significantly enhances local editing capabilities. In internal testing, the model maintained visual consistency across 100 consecutive editing rounds on a single base image. It allowed precise adjustments to fine details—such as rings, eyeglass frames, and clothing—without causing color shifts or degrading unmodified areas.

Seedream 5.5 also improves rendering for lighting, material textures, skin details, and dense small text. It is currently rolling out across ByteDance's platform suite, including Jimeng, Doubao, Doubao Workspace, and Volcengine Ark.

title_zh: LG 免费开放 K-EXAONE 2.5 模型 API
content_zh:
LG AI 研究院 11 月 9 日在 EXAONE API Platform 开放 K-EXAONE 2.5。开发者、初创公司、企业及研究机构可以申请 API 密钥，免费调用模型，用于开发服务和研究。

K-EXAONE 2.5 是在 LG 今年 8 月公布的版本上追加训练的技术验证模型，面向代码编写、网页检索和工作流自动化等任务。LG 公布了基于公开数据集的自测结果，其中评估真实软件开发任务的 SWE-Bench Pro 得分为 59.2，评估网页信息检索的 BrowseComp 得分为 78.0。
title_en: LG AI Research Opens Free API Access for K-EXAONE 2.5 Model
content_en:
LG AI Research has officially opened free API access to K-EXAONE 2.5 via the EXAONE API Platform. Developers, startups, enterprises, and research institutions can now apply for API keys to leverage the model for service development and academic research at no cost.

K-EXAONE 2.5 is a technical verification model built upon the foundation LG unveiled in August, specifically optimized for automated coding, web retrieval, and workflow execution. 

According to LG's public benchmark evaluations, the model achieved a score of 59.2 on SWE-Bench Pro (measuring real-world software engineering tasks) and 78.0 on BrowseComp (evaluating web information retrieval capabilities).

title_zh: 百度披露 ERNIE Evolve，已用于优化文心 5.5 Flash 推理
content_zh:
百度文心 11 月 9 日公开了自动研究系统 ERNIE Evolve，并披露已用它优化文心 5.5 Flash 的推理效率。系统会根据历史实验结果提出研究方向，再由多个智能体分工选择代码起点、修改代码。每轮改动须通过独立评测和复核，实验代码和结果会留给后续研究使用。

百度在技术博客中列出了三类实际研发任务，包括昆仑芯 P800 上的低时延推理、GPU 上的确定性推理吞吐，以及单并发解码速度。在 P800 的低时延任务中，团队限定改动范围为芯片适配插件，保持模型和部署方式不变。系统先后尝试融合算子、投机解码以及调度和通信优化，最优版本的生成速度达到初始基线的 623.6%，并通过了团队的正确性检查。

百度称，接下来计划将这套方法用于训练系统优化、模型能力研究和评测体系迭代，并继续限制系统的权限和资源范围。
title_en: Baidu Discloses ERNIE Evolve System, Boosting ERNIE 5.5 Flash Inference Efficiency
content_en:
Baidu's ERNIE team has revealed ERNIE Evolve, an automated research system currently used to optimize the inference efficiency of ERNIE 5.5 Flash. The system utilizes a multi-agent framework to propose research hypotheses, select code starting points, and execute modifications, with every iteration subject to independent evaluation and verification.

In practical application tests, Baidu tasked the system with low-latency inference optimization on its native Kunlunxin P800 chips. Confined to adapting plugin code without altering the underlying model, ERNIE Evolve implemented operator fusion, speculative decoding, and scheduling enhancements. The resulting optimal iteration boosted generation speed to 623.6% of the initial baseline while passing all correctness checks.

Baidu plans to expand ERNIE Evolve into training system optimization, core capability research, and evaluation iterations, while maintaining strict controls over the system's permissions and resources.

title_zh: Meta 推出小模型 Muse Ember，专门处理 AI 助手的重复任务
content_zh:
Meta 发布多模态模型 Muse Ember，面向需要反复执行的任务，例如编程中的小步骤、工具调用、文档摘要和字段提取。它是 Meta 首个使用 Muse Wonder Full 训练的模型，已在 Muse Code 和 Meta Model API 上线，支持 Responses API。

Muse Ember 支持 100 万 token 的上下文。提示不超过 20 万 token 时，API 每百万输入 token 收费 0.10 美元，每百万输出 token 收费 0.50 美元。
title_en: Meta Launches Muse Ember, a Lightweight AI Model for Repetitive Tasks
content_en:
Meta has unveiled **Muse Ember**, a lightweight multimodal AI model specifically designed to automate routine tasks such as micro-coding steps, tool invocation, document summarization, and data extraction. It marks the first model trained using Meta's Muse Wonder Full framework and is now accessible via Muse Code and the Meta Model API, supporting the Responses API.

The model offers a substantial 1-million-token context window. For prompts under 200,000 tokens, API pricing is set at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens.

title_zh: 门店贴出「买烟优先结账」，零食有鸣客服称会核实
content_zh:
近日，一家零食有鸣门店贴出「购买香烟者优先结账」的告示，引发消费者对排队规则的质疑。11 月 9 日，零食有鸣客服向界面新闻表示，公司没有就此出台文件，客服会把线索转交相应监督部门核实。

客服还介绍，门店售卖卷烟须先取得烟草专卖零售许可证，货源由门店向当地烟草公司采购，品牌总部不参与进货。对于加盟门店的经营问题，品牌方有权介入管理。
title_en: Chinese Snack Chain Investigates Store Granting Priority Checkout to Cigarette Buyers
content_en:
Chinese snack retail chain *Snack Youming* has drawn public controversy after one of its franchise outlets posted a sign giving priority checkout to cigarette buyers. In response to consumer complaints regarding unfair queuing rules, customer service clarified on November 9 that headquarters never issued such a rule and has referred the incident to internal oversight departments for investigation.

The company added that while franchise stores independently obtain tobacco licenses and procure stock from local suppliers without central involvement, headquarters retains the authority to intervene in and manage franchisee operational issues.

title_zh: 12 月起，进口小客车可在「交管 12123」网上办结上牌
content_zh:
公安部交通管理局宣布，自 12 月 1 日起，购买进口小客车的车主可通过「交管 12123」App 在线办结新车选号、登记上牌业务，无需前往窗口。交管部门将在共享车辆销售发票、购置税和保险信息的基础上，接入进口小客车预查验信息。

同批措施还允许汽车生产企业网上申领试验车临时号牌。企业出示电子营业执照，即可办理新车上牌、二手车过户等业务，并可通过 App 网上注册，查询企业名下车辆状态及违法事故信息。

直辖市、省会城市、自治区首府及计划单列市将试点 App 智能客服「交管小安」，支持边咨询边办理业务。
title_en: China to Enable Fully Online Vehicle Registration for Imported Passenger Cars Starting December
content_en:
Starting December 1, owners of imported passenger vehicles in China will be able to complete license plate selection and registration entirely online via the "Traffic Management 12123" app, bypassing the need to visit physical service counters. The platform will integrate shared sales invoices, purchase tax, insurance details, and imported vehicle pre-inspection data to streamline registration.

As part of the new policy package, automakers will also be allowed to apply online for temporary test-vehicle plates. Using electronic business licenses, corporate entities can register new cars, transfer used vehicles, and track fleet status and traffic violation records directly through the app.

Additionally, major cities across China will pilot an AI customer service assistant called "Jiaoguan Xiao'an," enabling users to get real-time assistance while completing transactions inside the app.

title_zh: Netflix 推进《卡坦岛》真人电影，据报将由尼兄弟编剧执导
content_zh:
据 Deadline 报道，曾执导《迷失之城》的亚伦·尼和亚当·尼将为 Netflix 编剧并执导《卡坦岛》真人电影。这是 Netflix 去年拿下这款桌游的全球改编权后，首个披露主创阵容的真人电影项目。

《卡坦岛》由德国桌游设计师克劳斯·托伊伯创作，玩家在岛上争取有限资源、结盟交易并建设定居点。Netflix 此前宣布与桌游发行商 Asmodee 合作，开发以《卡坦岛》为基础的真人、动画和非虚构内容。
title_en: Netflix Taps The Nee Brothers to Write and Direct Live-Action 'Catan' Film
content_en:
Netflix is officially moving forward with its live-action film adaptation of the iconic board game *Catan*, bringing on Aaron and Adam Nee (*The Lost City*) to write and direct the feature, according to *Deadline*. This marks the first major creative development disclosed since the streaming giant acquired global rights to the franchise last year.

Originally created by German designer Klaus Teuber, *Catan* challenges players to compete for scarce resources, negotiate trades, and build thriving settlements. The feature film is part of a broader collaboration between Netflix and board game publisher Asmodee to produce live-action, animated, and non-scripted content based on the beloved property.

title_zh: 郑雨盛主演武打片《杀生簿》国际销售权由 Finecut 拿下
content_zh:
据 Deadline 和 Variety 报道，韩国电影销售公司 Finecut 拿下武打片《杀生簿》（The Hit List）的国际销售权。影片由执导过《狼狩猎》和《伦敦黑帮》第三季的金泓善执导，已于今年 10 月开拍。

影片改编自 Kakao 平台一部浏览量超过 1.2 亿次的网漫。故事发生在朝鲜王朝，《首尔之春》演员郑雨盛饰演权臣韩明浍，《鱿鱼游戏》演员魏嘏隽饰演首阳大君，后者借韩明浍之力争夺年幼侄子的王位。

《伦敦黑帮》第三季的摄影指导拉斯·考克斯和灯光师基兰·韦茨也加入了本片。
title_en: Finecut Lands Global Sales Rights for Jung Woo-sung and Wi Ha-jun Action Epic 'The Hit List'
content_en:
South Korean sales outfit Finecut has nabbed international sales rights for *The Hit List*, an upcoming period action feature directed by Kim Hong-sun (*Project Wolf Hunting*, *Gangs of London* Season 3). Filming officially began in October.

Adapted from a hit Kakao webtoon with over 120 million views, the film is set during the Joseon Dynasty. *Squid Game* star Wi Ha-jun plays Prince Suyang, who aligns with powerful courtier Han Myeong-hoe, played by Jung Woo-sung (*12.12: The Day*), in a high-stakes plot to seize the throne from his young nephew.

The project also reunites director Kim with key crew members from *Gangs of London* Season 3, including Director of Photography Lars Cox and gaffer Kieran Weitz.
